goal: Prepare the Lemon Curd. Heat a bainmarie on medium-low heat. Add butter and wait for it to melt. Then add lemon juice, zest, raspberry juice, sugar, and eggs and whisk together until sugar melts into the mix and stir continuously. The lemon curd should begin to thicken and small bubbles will begin to form on the surface, about 40 minutes. Remove from heat once the lemon curd is thick enough for the whisk to leave marks on the surface.

Heat butter in a pot over medium heat until the butter melts. Add onion; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4 to 6 minutes. Stir in carrots and mix until properly coated. Add water and broth; bring to a lively simmer over high heat.  Reduce heat to maintain a lively simmer and cook until very tender, about 25 minutes.

recipe: Chickpea and Spinach Curry with Rice
goal: Add the onions and when they start to sizzle add the whole spices and chillies. Cook on a low heat until the onions are starting to brown.

In a non-stick pan, on medium to high heat, add seasoned chicken breast. Cook for 5-10 mins, stirring regularly, until chicken breast is cooked through, showing a golden-brown colour all over and slightly charred.
Build the wraps: On a tortilla wrap, add shredded lettuce, chopped tomatoes, chopped onion, spicy chicken and creamy hot sauce, then wrap into a burrito shaped roll or whatever shape desired.

Add the tuna, coriander, beans, spinach, bell peppers, carrots, celery, onion, cherry tomatoes, cucumbers, and spinach. At this point, you can cover the bowl and refrigerate it until you're ready to serve, up to 6 hours.
Meanwhile, finely dice the tomatoes and finely slice the red onion. Mix with the zingy lemon juice and season well. Set aside.
To a large mixing bowl, add chicken breast, 1 tbsp of olive oil, oregano, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, pepper, and lemon juice, then mix until combined.
Preheat the oven to 200 degrees C, fan 180 degrees C, gas 6. Line a large roasting tray with baking paper, remove the stalks from the mushrooms and place them on the tray.
Peel the potatoes and chop them into small chunks.
Add the carrot, celery, bell peppers, and mushrooms and cook for a further 2-3 minutes.
Crumble up the biscuit and combine with the mixture
Add the chicken chunks in (they should have been cooked 80%)
Place butter and pitted dates in a pan and heat until dates are soft.
Mix all the ingredients except for the chicken. Pour into a large container and add the chicken thighs.

The meat: Sweat one chopped onion in a pot, for a few minutes and then add minced garlic, then place the meat in the pot and on high heat while continuing stirring let the meat cook until the red color turns into more brownish, the idea here is not to fully cook the meat, but perhaps to get all the water out, this will help to get rid of all the water residue that comes out of the meat.
Next, add in the vegetables and nuts and fry for 2 minutes. Cook in batches so as not to overload the pan and boil them.

While the pasta cooks, add freshly grated parmigano cheese to the crushed black peppercorns on very low heat. Gradually add a cup of the boiling cooking water to the bowl, constantly mixing and adjusting as necessary to melt the cheese and obtain a silky, smooth sauce that’s able to completely coat the pasta. Finish with a knob of butter to emulsify the sauce

STUFFING. Start preparing the meat stuffing. Sweat one chopped onion in a pot, for a few minutes and then add minced garlic, then place the meat in the pot and on high heat while continuing stirring let the meat cook until the red color turns into more brownish, the idea here is not to fully cook the meat, but perhaps to get all the water out, this will help to get rid of all the water residue that comes out of the meat so it can help the meat stick to the dough while baking.
Puree the soup in batches in a blender until smooth. (Use caution when pureeing hot liquids.) Stir in spice mix and fresh coriander.
Build the wraps: On a tortilla wrap, add shredded lettuce, chopped tomatoes, chopped onion, spicy chicken and creamy hot sauce, then wrap into a burrito shaped roll or whatever shape desired.
Slice 1 medium onion and slit few green chilies. Grate ginger and few cloves of garlic.
Use a cookie scoop or a spoon to scoop out about 1 inch dough balls. Place 2 inches apart on the prepared cookie sheet
Add the Hibiscus (Zobo) flowers and chopped ginger into a pot a fill with water
Add mangoes, ice cubes, cold water, honey, coconut milk, and yogurt to blender.
In the meantime, prepare the puff pastry. Roll out the puff pastry to about 10 inches by 14 inches, then cut into squares.

Fry the potatoes on a medium-heat pan with abundant oil turning the potatoes frequently so that they don't burn. Split larger chunks with a spatula as they soften while cooking to ensure an even size of chunks. Add a pinch of salt while frying the potatoes.

Add chopped onions to the pan. Cook the onion for around 6 to 7 minutes or until it turns light golden brown. Keep stirring it continuously so that it doesn't burn and keep heat on medium. Add chopped tomato to the pan and saute them with onions.
Wash and chop the fresh chestnut and shiitake mushrooms.

Wash and peel the sweet potatoes and chop into bite-sized pieces. Put the sweet potatoes in a bowl and add the olive oil, cumin, and chili powder. Mix well and pour the mixture onto a baking tray. Roast for 10 minutes.
Start by mixing the melted butter, sweetened condensed milk with the cocoa powder. Combine them really well together, but it's okay if there are a few small lumps.
On a lightly floured surface, roll out to the thickness of a 1 pound coin. Cut into 1cm strips, then twist the strips 3-4 times.
In a separate small bowl, combine fat free yoghurt, sriracha hot sauce, parsley, salt, pepper and lemon juice until smooth.
Add in the chopped vegetables (courgette, bamboo shoots and chili. Chili is optional)
To serve, cut the baguette in half and butter both sides. Add the bacon, scrambled eggs, and cheese.
Layer the cooled raspberry lemon curd onto the top of the tart. Serve immediately. Store any leftovers in the refrigerator.

When the rice is cooked take the pan off the heat, add butter and scatter over grated parmesan or Grana Padano cheese and tear and scatter a handful of parsley leaves. Chop the rest of the parsley and save for later.
Next, chop your cucumbers, cherry tomatoes, carrot, coriander, and red onion, and add them to a large bowl alongside the beans and diced tomatoes.
Dredge each Chicken-cheese ball into flour, then dip into egg and roll in the breadcrumbs, ensuring the entire surface of the chicken ball is covered in breadcrumbs.

Slice the bacon and place in a non-stick frying pan on a medium heat with half a tablespoon of olive oil and a really good pinch of black pepper. Leave it to get super-golden and crispy, tossing occasionally, then add the peas

Put the egg and egg yolk in a large bowl with the sugar and a pinch of salt. Vigorously whisk by hand or with electric beaters, until the mixture is pale yellow and voluminous. Very gently fold in the melted chocolate mixture with a large metal spoon, taking care not to knock too much air out of the batter. Repeat with the flour.
Rinse the chickpeas, then place the chickpeas on a towel and lightly towel dry them so they aren't wet from rinsing. You can remove any loose skins at this time too.
Pulse all the dressing ingredients in a food processor until mostly smooth.
Heat the oil in a frying pan over a medium-high heat. Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes, stirring often, until the onion softens.
Add sugar, give it a good stir and leave to cool.
Chop carrot, coriander and avocado and add to bowl with tabbouleh salad.
Add the minced beef and cook for 5-6 minutes, until browned. Stir often, breaking up any large chunks of meat with a spatula.
Add the tomato pasta sauce, oregano, tinned tomatoes, salt, and pepper. Stir and bring to the boil. Turn down the heat and simmer for 15 -20 minutes until thickened.
